reason: Daycare went up and money is tight, so $13 a visit plus a sibling is a lot when the church hall and parks are free. I'd take the free first visit to look, but I wouldn't count on paying after that.
objection: $13 a kid every time adds up fast, and it feels fancy and Instagram-y for Salisbury. I don't know that my kids would play enough to be worth it.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in around $8 to $9 on weekdays, or the moms group rate actually working for my group so I'm not paying full price myself.
